# RUM Classic JS Library Versions

Shows latest JavaScript library version per RUM classic app from workflow events.

Expected events:
- RUMJSVersion|<app_id>|<js_version>|<fetched_at>
- RUMJSVersionSyncSummary|<app_count>|<versions_found>|<fetched_at>

1.title: Apps Synced (Latest Run)
1.query: fetch events | fields ts = timestamp, src = event.properties.source, app_count_raw = event.properties.app_count | filter src == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(app_count_raw) | sort ts desc | limit 1 | fields app_count = toLong(app_count_raw)

2.title: Distinct JS Versions (Latest Run)
2.query: fetch events | fields ts = timestamp, src = event.properties.source, versions_found_raw = event.properties.versions_found | filter src == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(versions_found_raw) | sort ts desc | limit 1 | fields versions_found = toLong(versions_found_raw)

3.title: Last Sync Time (Latest Run)
3.query: fetch events | fields ts = timestamp, src = event.properties.source, fetched_at = event.properties.fetched_at, app_count_raw = event.properties.app_count | filter src == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(fetched_at) and isNotNull(app_count_raw) | sort ts desc | limit 1 | fields fetched_at

4.title: Apps by JS Library Version (Latest Per App)
4.query: fetch events | fields ts = timestamp, src = event.properties.source, app_id = event.properties.application_id, js_version = event.properties.js_library_version | filter src == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(app_id) and isNotNull(js_version) | sort ts desc | dedup app_id | summarize apps = count(), by: {js_version} | sort apps desc, js_version desc

5.title: Latest JS Library Version by Application
5.query: fetch events | fields ts = timestamp, src = event.properties.source, app_id = event.properties.application_id, js_version = event.properties.js_library_version, fetched_at = event.properties.fetched_at, app_name = event.properties.application_name | fieldsAdd app_name = coalesce(app_name, app_id) | filter src == "rum_classic_api" and isNotNull(app_id) and isNotNull(js_version) | sort ts desc | dedup app_id | fields app_name, app_id, js_version, fetched_at, last_seen = ts | sort app_name asc
